build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build:cli-bundle && npm run build:frontend

windows.title: AI Local Environment Checker - Controlled Installation Preview

bundle.shortDescription: Safe local AI development environment checker.
bundle.longDescription: AI Local Environment Checker is a safe preview desktop application for diagnosing local AI development readiness. v0.9.0-alpha.1 adds product UI polish, admin permission approval UX, command approval review, rollback visibility, theme switching, and English/Simplified Chinese language selection while the GUI keeps real installation disabled by default.
